core_obligations: Statement (lines 1758-1761): if Gamma proves A in the axiomatic calculus then Gamma semantically entails A.

Induction on derivations (proof lines 1763-1815): with no inference steps every formula is an axiom instance or in Gamma, and axioms are valid by the previous proposition; the modus-ponens case applies the induction hypothesis to the shorter derivations of B and B -> A and closes by the semantic deduction theorem.

Quantifier-rule case (lines 1777-1815): from Gamma proves C -> B(c) with c not in Gamma, C, or the universal closure, the proof moves to structures, varied the eigenvariable assignment, used extensionality of sentences and of formulas under the substitution B(c) = subst(A,c,x), and concluded Gamma entails C -> forall x B(x); the author leaves the dual existential-inverse variant of this case as an exercise.
proof_roadmap: Base: no inference steps; axioms valid by the previous proposition.
Modus ponens: induction hypothesis plus the semantic deduction theorem.
Quantifier rule: eigenvariable assignment manipulation through the extensionality facts.
difficulty_reason: Soundness theorem (statement 1758-1761, proof 1763-1815): induction on derivation length with the axiom, modus-ponens and quantifier-rule cases all carried, the last through a full structure/assignment argument; the author defers only the dual existential-inverse variant of the quantifier case to an exercise. H2.
